method: Pinned FBX object surfaces; centimetres to metres; rigid body and four local hand/foot bone fits; C1 spatial blending into forearms/shins; maximum 0.1 mm meshoptimizer error; conforming tessellation to 10 mm maximum source edges; inverse-transpose field normals, quantized. Female follows the existing non-breast body morph after the hand/foot correction.
limitations: Estimated registration between reference assemblies with differing proportions; sampled bone distances do not validate nerve courses or attachments.
Source mesh names and branch courses are retained. Not a complete nervous system, independently reviewed anatomy, or a female-specific nerve dataset.
